annotations.title: Convert between UF and Chilean pesos

description: Convert an amount from UF to Chilean pesos or back, using the UF value of a given date, and return the UF value, date and source. The UF is published in advance: from the 10th of each month, any date up to the 9th of the next month is available (e.g. on 11 November, the UF of 30 November or 9 December). Later dates answer not_published with the expected availability date. Use it for rents, insurance and contracts in UF; use latam_indexacion for UVA, UVR or UDI. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/uf via x402.

fecha.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; default today. Past dates, or future dates up to the 9th of next month (UF is published in advance).

monto.description: Amount to convert, in UF or pesos depending on direccion.
